label: NaCl box (Curve25519+XSalsa20-Poly1305), wire nonce+ciphertext+mac, strict key-length validation, decrypt fail-closed null - defeats relay eavesdropping/tampering
baseKey/sessionKey separation: HKDF-SHA256(baseShared, salt=hostNonce+clientNonce, info=nodeterm-relay-session-v2) defeats cross-session replay of recorded boxes
Sealed 9-byte [role][seq][tag] header inside the box keeps all security metadata in authenticated plaintext - defeats relay metadata forgery
Role byte must equal PEER role; own-role box = relay reflection, dropped - defeats reflection attacks
Inbound seq strictly increasing (recvSeq init -1, drop <=), per-direction counters reset per connection - defeats intra-session replay/reorder
After ready, plaintext hello/ready ignored without re-key or close; host re-asserts peerKeyIntact per frame - defeats live-session re-key/key substitution
Out-of-band 6-digit SAS from baseKey with mutual both-humans-confirm and pin-once-both-ends; branded MutualApproval latch safe by construction - defeats relay MITM/key substitution

confirmRemote driven ONLY by onTunnel frames decrypted under the session key with peer role and fresh seq; TRUST_CONFIRM consumed, never dispatched; one MutualApproval per pairing - defeats relay-injected/replayed confirms
Endianness traps: box seq LE (high then low), pty sidLen BE uint16, SAS fold BE - mixed order blinds anti-replay and breaks interop
Approval may only advance from a frame that decrypted under THIS session's key, carried the peer role byte, and beat the replay counter; plaintext can never reach the trust gate
